definitions.explanation: Refers to each person separately within a group. Emphasizes individual responsibility or action.

examples.japanese: {各自|かくじ}{持|も}ち{物|もの}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check your own belongings individually.

examples.japanese: {昼食|ちゅうしょく}は{各自|かくじ}で{用意|ようい}すること。
examples.english: Each person should prepare their own lunch.

examples.japanese: {費用|ひよう}は{各自|かくじ}{負担|ふたん}となります。
examples.english: Costs will be borne by each individual.

notes:
REGISTER: Formal. Often used in announcements, instructions, and official documents.

PATTERNS:
・{各自|かくじ}で (by oneself, individually)
・{各自|かくじ}の (each person's)
・{各自|かくじ}{負担|ふたん} (individual expense)
・{各自|かくじ}{判断|はんだん} (individual judgment)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{各々|おのおの} (each one - slightly more formal/literary)
・{銘々|めいめい} (each person - casual to neutral)
・それぞれ (each, respectively - common, neutral)
・{個人|こじん} (individual - emphasizes the person)

NOTE: {各自|かくじ} emphasizes individual responsibility within a group context.
